notes.title: Added dual wielding weapons
notes.content:
1. One-handed weapons can have a second weapon. The default weapon for new players is two sabers.
2. Weapons are harder to shoot down
3. Add the game tutorial.

notes.title: Redesigned UI
notes.content:
1. Redesigned the UI 
2. The grab weapon is changed to a fixed angle (you can change it back to the original free grab in the game settings)
3. Fixed the problem of unbalanced power between hands

notes.title: Balance Updates
notes.content:
1、Increase the collision judgment between weapons, so that the defense is more favorable (damage judgment range remains unchanged)
2. To compensate for the lack of body judgment. Jumping will make the headset bigger, increasing the range of judgment. Crouching headset becomes smaller, reducing the range of judgment.
3、Fix the menu can not be closed bug

notes.title: Experience optimization
notes.content:
1. Accelerated hand mapping, making the control more flexible
2. update the robot animation to make it more human-like (match game will also have a companion computer person before other players enter, and disappear after the player joins)

notes.content:

notes.title: Add restrictions on the range of movement
notes.content:
1. Add restrictions on the range of movement to limit unfair behavior in large rooms
2. Re-adjust the feel of the weapon to make the weapon more suitable

So far, all the basics are all done. If you encounter any bugs playing with a delay of less than 50ms, please leave a message here in time and I will fix it immediately. I will make scene art in the next month. Please tell me any bugs you encounter!

tags.feature: 1. Add restrictions on the range of movement to limit unfair behavior in large rooms

tags.balance_change: 2. Re-adjust the feel of the weapon to make the weapon more suitable

notes.title: Extended dagger
notes.content:
1. Increase the dagger to about 1 meter and keep the sword at 1.4 meters unchanged
2. Increased the impact force of slashing on other weapons, making it easier for straight stabs to be blocked and the flaws after blocking increase.
3. Weapon damage is halved. If it causes fatal damage, a slight swing speed is required.
